title: Rulebook FAQ module (ch. VIII edge cases)
instructions:
Implement the rulebook FAQ module in game-core/src/engine/rules-faq.ts (NO classes, NO mutation, pure functions only). This module captures the official FAQ rulings from rulebook Chapter VIII (see docs/rules/re1_rulebook.txt lines ~1399-1411 and RULES-DIGEST.md "FAQ nuggets"). The engine currently applies these rules inline in explore.ts; this module makes them reusable, testable, and canonical. It must NOT import from any other engine file — only from ../types. It is pure: same inputs -> same outputs, no state, no GameState access.

Imports (exact, and ONLY this):
```ts
import type { CharacterAbility } from '../types';
```

STYLE RULES: strict TypeScript with noUncheckedIndexedAccess. No `any`. No default exports. Every function is pure. Export ONLY the four functions below.

----------------- The official rulings being encoded ----------------
1. "Does Jill Valentine's Level 1 ability add Damage to the Grenade's effect?" — "A: Yes it does." Jill L1 = `{ kind: 'explosivesPlusDamage', amount: 5, level: 1 }` (already in the CharacterAbility union and in the premier data for ch-009). Rule: when a player with this ability uses N Explosive-tagged weapons in one Explore, add `amount` damage for EACH such weapon used (one Grenade -> +5, two explosives -> +10, etc.). The caller counts the explosive weapons; this function applies the multiplier.
2. "The Rocket Launcher is considered an Explosive — does Jill never Trash it with her Level 2 ability?" — "A: That is correct, since the Rocket Launcher will always go to her Discard Pile instead." Jill L2 = `{ kind: 'explosivesGoToDiscardInsteadOfTrash', level: 2 }`. Rule: explosive weapons used by this player go to their DISCARD pile instead of being trashed/removed after use.
3. "The Gatling Gun Majini says for every 10 Ammo I have he deals +5 Damage — does that mean every 10 Ammo CARD?" — "A: No, the effect is referring to every increment of 10 Ammo you have in your total. For example, if you played two Ammo X 30 cards, you have a total of 60 Ammo for the turn, meaning the Gatling Gun Majini would get +30 Damage." Rule: bonus damage = amountPer10 * floor(totalAmmo / 10). (60 ammo with +5 per 10 -> +30. NOT per ammo card.)
4. "Partial effects — do as much as you can" (rulebook: "If a Player cannot perform all of the listed effects, then the Player does as much as he can"). For +X Cards this means: if the Inventory has fewer than X cards, draw all of it, then shuffle the Discard into the Inventory and draw the remainder; if STILL short, draw what remains. So the maximum a player can draw at one moment equals inventory.length + discard.length, and the actual draw count is min(requested, that maximum).

----------------- EXACT SIGNATURES + BEHAVIOR ----------------

```ts
// Ruling 1. Returns the added damage for using `explosiveWeaponsUsed` explosive
// weapons, or 0 when the player has no explosivesPlusDamage ability.
export function explosivesPlusDamageFor(abilities: readonly CharacterAbility[] | undefined, explosiveWeaponsUsed: number): number
```
Behavior: if `explosiveWeaponsUsed <= 0` return 0. If `abilities` is undefined return 0. Find the ability `{ kind: 'explosivesPlusDamage', level: 1 }` (match kind AND level 1; the caller passes level-1-appropriate abilities). If found, return `amount * explosiveWeaponsUsed`; else 0. Do NOT match level 2 or any other kind. Do NOT validate the list — first match wins via .find().

```ts
// Ruling 2. True when the player's abilities include explosivesGoToDiscardInsteadOfTrash at level 2.
export function explosiveWeaponsGoToDiscard(abilities: readonly CharacterAbility[] | undefined): boolean
```
Behavior: undefined -> false. Match kind 'explosivesGoToDiscardInsteadOfTrash' AND level 2. Any other ability (including explosivesPlusDamage, generic, level mismatches) -> false.

```ts
// Ruling 3. Gatling Gun Majini-style "per full 10 Ammo" scaling.
export function damagePerFull10Ammo(ammo: number, amountPer10: number): number
```
Behavior: amountPer10 * Math.floor(ammo / 10). Negative inputs are not expected; if ammo <= 0 return 0 (Math.floor of negatives would break the rule — guard it). Examples: (0,5)->0, (9,5)->0, (10,5)->5, (59,5)->25, (60,5)->30, (65,5)->30.

```ts
// Ruling 4. Maximum number of cards a player can currently draw
// (Inventory top-to-bottom, then Discard reshuffled).
export function maxDrawableCards(inventoryCount: number, discardCount: number): number
```
Behavior: inventoryCount + discardCount, but never negative: if either is negative treat it as 0 (defensive — callers pass array lengths so this only guards misuse). Examples: (5,0)->5, (2,0)->2, (2,5)->7, (0,0)->0, (5,3)->8.

```ts
// Ruling 4 continued. Actual cards drawn = min(requested, maxDrawableCards) — exposes
// the "do as much as you can" clamp for +X Cards effects.
export function effectiveDrawCount(requested: number, inventoryCount: number, discardCount: number): number
```
Behavior: if requested <= 0 return 0; else Math.min(requested, maxDrawableCards(inventoryCount, discardCount)). Examples: (5,5,0)->5, (5,2,0)->2, (5,2,5)->5, (8,2,5)->7, (0,2,5)->0, (3,0,0)->0.

The file must also carry a one-line comment per export naming the FAQ ruling it encodes ("FAQ ch. VIII: ..."). Compiles with npx tsc --noEmit under the project's strict config.

----------------- File 2: game-core/src/engine/rules-faq.test.ts -----------------
Vitest (globals: test/expect). Import the four functions from './rules-faq' and CharacterAbility type from '../types'. Write EXACTLY these tests:

1. 'jill l1 adds damage to each explosive weapon' — abilities [{ kind: 'explosivesPlusDamage', amount: 5, level: 1 }]: (abilities, 1) -> 5; (abilities, 2) -> 10; (abilities, 0) -> 0.
2. 'jill l1 with no explosives used' — any abilities, 0 weapons -> 0 (use the [explosivesPlusDamage] set and 0).
3. 'no abilities means no explosive bonus' — (undefined, 3) -> 0; ([], 3) -> 0; ([{ kind: 'generic', level: 1 }], 3) -> 0.
4. 'level-2 only ability is not matched' — [{ kind: 'explosivesPlusDamage', amount: 5, level: 2 }] with 1 weapon -> 0 (level mismatch).
5. 'mixed abilities pick the level-1 explosivesPlusDamage' — [{ kind: 'noHealingNoNonInfectedAttach', level: 1 }, { kind: 'explosivesPlusDamage', amount: 7, level: 1 }, { kind: 'explosivesGoToDiscardInsteadOfTrash', level: 2 }] with 3 weapons -> 21.
6. 'jill l2 routes explosive weapons to discard' — [{ kind: 'explosivesGoToDiscardInsteadOfTrash', level: 2 }] -> true; with undefined -> false; with [] -> false.
7. 'explosives go to discard only at level 2' — [{ kind: 'explosivesGoToDiscardInsteadOfTrash', level: 1 }] -> false; [{ kind: 'explosivesPlusDamage', amount: 5, level: 1 }, { kind: 'explosivesGoToDiscardInsteadOfTrash', level: 2 }] -> true.
8. 'gatling majini scales per full 10 ammo' — (9,5)->0, (10,5)->5, (59,5)->25, (60,5)->30, (65,5)->30, (100,5)->50.
9. 'gatling majini zero or negative ammo' — (0,5)->0, (-5,5)->0 (guard).
10. 'max drawable is inventory plus discard' — (5,0)->5, (2,0)->2, (2,5)->7, (0,0)->0, (5,3)->8.
11. 'max drawable clamps negatives to zero' — (-1,5)->5, (5,-2)->5, (-1,-1)->0.
12. 'effective draw does as much as you can' — (5,5,0)->5, (5,2,0)->2, (5,2,5)->5, (8,2,5)->7, (3,0,0)->0, (0,2,5)->0.
13. 'effective draw with full discards' — (10,4,6)->10, (12,4,6)->10 (capped at 10 total).
14. test naming the rulebook example — 'rulebook example: two Ammo x30 = 60 ammo gives +30' — damagePerFull10Ammo(60, 5) -> 30; and with three Ammo x20 (60 total) same -> 30; and one Ammo x30 + one x20 (50 total) -> 25. This pins the "per increment of 10 TOTAL ammo, not per card" ruling: damagePerFull10Ammo(50, 5) === 25.

Do NOT add or reorder tests; do not add exports. All expected values follow the rulings above — trust them.
